draft.summary: Show customers the status of their order
draft.description:
## Context
Type: Story (created as Task; this Jira project has no Story type).

Phase: 1.

Customers ask "where is my order?" all day. The team agreed on a status page, updated by counter staff.

## User Story
As a customer, I want to see the status of my order, so that I do not have to ask where it is.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: **Customer checks an order** (Happy path) — A customer opens the status page for their order. Expected: the page shows one of Received, In the oven, Ready for pickup or Delivered.
- AC2: **Staff update a status** (Happy path) — Counter staff change an order's status with one tap. Expected: the customer's status page shows the new status.

## Business Rules
The status page ships before any notification feature and is not blocked by the notification question.

## References, Risks and Dependencies
Risk: bad Wi-Fi at the counter in the afternoon can slow the page. Mitigation idea, not decided: keep showing the last known status when offline.

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Acceptance criteria met.
- [ ] Developer testing and sanity check completed.
- [ ] Peer review approved.
- [ ] QA validation approved.
- [ ] Demo completed.
- [ ] Documentation updated, if applicable.
- [ ] Release status and evidence recorded.

## Completion Evidence
Pending — to be linked as it becomes available.
